description: The LIVE catalog of what the fabrication network can do RIGHT NOW — no quote needed. Returns the services ledger (tapping, inserts, welding, bending, finishes… with each shop's own size/material/thickness windows), the network's sheet gauge ladder, the stocked hardware combinations (species x thread) with stocked lengths and shop counts — the most-stocked length is the steering default for an unspecified length — the finish options with their stocked color menus, every colour the network can make a part in (network_catalog.colors: per colour family, how many shops stock a material in it and how many coat in it, with the shades — ask for one by passing the family word as `color` with no finish), the material groups a picker shows (network_catalog.material_groups: Plastics, Metals, Woods, Foams, Rubbers, Composites, Paper cork and fabric… with the stock families live under each and the words that ask for them), and per-process manufacturability rules. This is live state, not a spec sheet: it changes as connectors join, leave, or have capability branches toggled, so call it fresh when the user asks what's possible (materials, gauges, hardware, colors, services) rather than answering from memory. PICKER COUNTS: pass `selection` (what the user has already picked: processes, materials, thickness_in, colors, finishes, finish_colors, vendors, vendors_exclude, each a list where any value will do) and the answer adds network_catalog.facets: for every material group and member, gauge rung, colour family, finish and finish colour the catalog lists, `shops` = how many shops the user can order from today declare they make the whole selection plus that option, and `maybe` = further shops whose catalog is silent on part of it (they might); each count sets that dimension's own picks aside. Only an option with shops 0 AND maybe 0 is impossible with the selection; never read a missing count as zero. facets.shops answers each shop against the selection (yes / no / unknown). The counts come from the shops' declared catalogs, nobody is contacted, and nothing on a quote changes. Without `selection` the answer is the same as before.

process.description: Advisory scope ("sheetmetal") — v1 returns the whole catalog either way; filter what you relay

selection.description: What is already picked, in a quote's own words, e.g. { "materials": ["acrylic"], "colors": ["green"], "vendors": ["SendCutSend"] }. When present the answer adds network_catalog.facets (shop counts per option for this selection). Add "vendors_exact": true only when the shop lists hold offer `vendor` slugs that must each mean that one connector (a name otherwise covers every connector of the shop). Omit it for the plain catalog
